A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel technique for reducing the complexity of the ME system of H.264 by configuring at coding-time the number of reference-frames and search area used for a given macro-block.

the proposed algorithm can be implemented in a software encoder to reduce the complexity by 50% with no loss in quality, and can be implemented in an hardware encoder to reduce the area by 30% and the power consumption by 40% with negligible loss in quality.

the proposed technique can be implemented with a very low cost and complexity, and it is able to achieve the same coding efficiency as the full H.264/ AVC standard, with a very high degree of parallelism.
